name: Death at the Gin Joint
tagline: Jazz, bathtub gin, and a body behind the bar.
description: Knock three times and whisper the password. Behind the false wall of a barber shop, the band plays hot, the gin is cold, and somebody has just taken a permanent nap in the back room. Flappers, gangsters, crooked cops and a torch singer with a past.
artStyle: Art deco poster illustration, gold and black geometric lines, smoky jazz club lighting
